# Bitmap

`Bitmap` is an object type. You don't create it directly: you get one from another call, then call its methods with a colon, e.g. `bitmap:width()`.

## Methods

| Function | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`width()`](width.md) | Return the bitmap width. | 1.1.0 |
| [`height()`](height.md) | Return the bitmap height. | 1.1.0 |
| [`rotate()`](rotate.md) | Return the rotated bitmap. | 1.5.9 |
